See size and duration limits. #### Authorizations OAuth2UserTokenUserToken Authorization string header required The access token received from the authorization server in the OAuth 2.0 flow. #### Body application/json card\_uri string Card URI parameter. community\_id string Community to post the tweet to. Pattern: `^[0-9]{1,19}$` direct\_message\_deep\_link string Direct message deep link. edit\_options object Edit an existing tweet rather than creating a new one. Show child attributes for\_super\_followers\_only boolean Restrict tweet to super followers. geo object Geo location for the tweet. Show child attributes made\_with\_ai boolean Disclose that the tweet contains AI-generated media. media object Media attachments. Show child attributes nullcast boolean If true, the tweet is not shown in the public timeline. paid\_partnership boolean Disclose that the tweet is a paid partnership. poll object Poll configuration. Show child attributes quote\_tweet\_id string Tweet ID to quote. Pattern: `^[0-9]{1,19}$` reply object Tweet reply configuration. Show child attributes reply\_settings enum Who can reply to this tweet. Available options: `following`, `mentionedUsers`, `subscribers`, `verified` share\_with\_followers boolean Share an exclusive (super-follower) tweet with all followers. text string default:"" Text of the tweet.
